== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Warrior]]s by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].
